001: Ivan, have you already familiarized yourself with the new confidentiality policy?
Yes, I read it last night. There are quite strict requirements for data storage.
I agree, now we can't use personal phones for work tasks.
This will create some inconvenience, but I understand why the company took this step.
The main thing is that all employees complete the training on time and sign the necessary documents.
I've already scheduled that for next week, so everything will be done on time.
002: Dmitry, do you know that the company is introducing a new remote work policy?
I heard a bit about it, but I didn't look into the details. What exactly is changing?
Now working from home is allowed two days a week, but you need approval from your manager.
That's great news! It would be much more convenient for me to work on reports in a quiet environment.
Just don't forget that on those days you have to be available during working hours.
Of course, I'm always reachable in the messenger, so there won't be any problems.
003: Olga, have you seen the updated code of business ethics?
Yes, I looked through it yesterday. I especially paid attention to the section about gifts from clients.
And you did the right thing. Now any gifts worth more than three thousand rubles need to be declared.
And what if the gift is non-material, for example, an invitation to an event?
In that case, you also need to notify the compliance department to avoid a conflict of interest.
Understood, I'll keep that in mind when dealing with our partners.
004: Sergey, have you already submitted your application for the internal training program?
Not yet, I'm actually looking through the list of available courses. Do you have any recommendations?
I signed up for the project management course, it seems very useful for our work.
Sounds good, but I'm leaning more toward the data analysis course.
That's also a good choice, especially since the company fully pays for the training.
Then I won't put it off and I'll send in my application today.
005: Anna, do you know that the company has tightened the rules for using corporate email?
Yes, I received the notice. Now you can't forward work emails to personal addresses.
Exactly, and this applies even to documents that don't contain confidential information.
I understand, this is related to the recent data leak at our competitors.
Absolutely right, management wants to minimize all possible risks.
Well, we'll have to get used to the new rules, even though it's not very convenient.
006: Ivan, have you heard about the new policy regarding overtime work?
Yes, now you need to get approval for overtime from the department head in advance.
Correct, and overtime hours will only be paid if there is written confirmation.
That's reasonable, but sometimes urgent situations come up when there's no time for approval.
In such cases, you need to notify the manager within twenty-four hours.
Okay, I'll remember this rule and act accordingly.
007: Maria, have you familiarized yourself with the new procurement regulations?
Yes, I read them yesterday. Now all orders have to go through a single system.
Exactly, and this applies even to small office supplies.
This will slow down the process a bit, but at least there will be full transparency of expenses.
I agree, and besides, the system itself will monitor budget compliance.
Great, so I'll need to train my team to work with this system.
008: Dmitry, do you know that the company is introducing mandatory employee rotation between departments?
I heard about it, but I didn't think it would affect our division.
It will, and pretty soon. The schedule for the next quarter has already been made.
To be honest, I'm a little worried, since I've been working in my field for a long time.
Don't worry, it's a great opportunity to broaden your horizons and gain new experience.
You're right, maybe it really will be good for me.
009: Olga, have you seen that the company updated its policy on social media?
Yes, now you can't post photos from work events without permission.
Correct, and this applies even to personal pages if the company name is mentioned there.
That's a pretty strict rule, but I understand why it's necessary.
Also, now you have to state that opinions on social media are personal.
I've already updated my profiles, so everything will be in line with the requirements.
010: Sergey, have you already familiarized yourself with the new procedure for requesting vacation?
Yes, now you have to submit the request no later than two weeks before the start of the vacation.
Exactly, and priority will be given to those who submitted their request earlier.
That's fair, especially during the summer when everyone wants to take time off.
By the way, I've already submitted my request for July, so I advise you to hurry up.
Thanks for the heads up, I'll take care of it today.
